children: ICICI Securities's research report on Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences

Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences (KIMS) delivered strong operating performance in Q2, with revenue growth accelerating to ~40% YoY, led by healthy traction across clusters and ramp-up at new hospitals. EBITDA grew a strong 31.5% YoY, though a drag from new hospitals in existing and new clusters led to a 130bps fall in margins to 20%. Healthy revenue traction at new hospitals has aided an EBITDA break-even at most of the hospitals. No major greenfield capex ahead and better traction at new hospitals will likely lead the company on course of sequential margin improvement ahead. We raise FY27/28E revenue by ~1–3% to factor in a faster ramp-up of new hospitals. Upgrade KIMS to BUY with an unchanged TP of INR 885, based on 27x FY28E adj. EV/EBITDA.
